 Order
This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

This writ petition has been filed by the petitioner Maheswar Behera with a prayer to direct the opposite party no.1, Land Acquisition Officer and Competent Authority, N.H.16, Bhubaneswar for recalculation and disbursement of the compensation to the petitioner as per the order dated 28.08.2019 passed by the learned Arbitrator in Arbitration Case No.52 of 2016 under Annexure-2 within a stipulated period.

Though the prayer has been made in one aspect, but the learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the Arbitrator's award is not correct and therefore, the petitioner wants to challenge the same.

sentences.text: Needless to say that there are alternative remedy available under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act to challenge the order passed by the Collector and District Magistrate -cum- Arbitrator, Cuttack in Arbitration Case No.52 of 2016 under Annexure-2.
It is open to the petitioner to seek appropriate remedy in accordance with law.
Accordingly, the writ petition stands disposed of.
Urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application.
( S.K. Sahoo) Judge ( S.S. Mishra) Judge RKM Signed by: RABINDRA KUMAR MISHRA
